name: AXM Review & Promotion Inbox
actions: submit an exact artifact for review
queue one to ten independent seats
discuss a held or rejected item
send an item to changed-digest repair
summary: One human review surface for read-only structural module evidence and a separate durable exact-artifact queue with one-to-ten independent seats, repair routing and digest-bound decisions.
notes: Structural candidates never enter the digest queue automatically and cannot be voted on. Exact-digest approval never applies an action by itself; the consuming service must verify the approved digest again.
